An unforgettable experience – fishing, snorkeling & the best BBQ in Vietnam
Dec 2025 • Couples
This tour was hands down one of the highlights of our trip and something we would recommend to absolutely everyone.
The day starts super smoothly with a hotel pick-up (and drop-off afterward), which is honestly cheaper and far more convenient than taking a Grab back and forth. Once you arrive, you can relax with a coffee while waiting for a short transfer by longboat to the larger, traditional fishing boat.
After about a 20-minute ride, the fun begins. You start with fishing, and you can choose between a fishing rod, traditional hand fishing, or try both. There’s no pressure—you fish until you’re happy or until you’ve caught enough for the BBQ (and don’t worry, the BBQ has more than enough food anyway).
Next up is snorkeling, where you can look for sea urchins and discover all kinds of fascinating underwater life. If you’re nervous, there’s absolutely nothing to worry about. You begin in shallow water where you can stand, and only go deeper if you feel comfortable. An, our guide, was incredibly patient and helpful, staying close and supporting anyone who wasn’t fully confident yet.
After snorkeling, you head to a stunning, secluded beach where the team prepares a BBQ just for your group. We were completely alone—it felt like paradise. The food was unbelievable and, without exaggeration, the best meal we had in Vietnam, and we ate at some very good places. You can even try raw sea urchin and scallops, which I highly recommend. Surprisingly, they’re even better raw than cooked (at least according to my taste buds!).
Once you’ve finished your idyllic beach picnic, you can either go snorkeling again—if you haven’t already eaten too much—or simply relax and soak in the scenery. We chose to head back, happily full and already dreaming of a well-deserved afternoon nap at the hotel.
This is not your average tourist experience. No crowds, no rushing, no lines—just a small group or family, total relaxation, lots of fun, incredible food, and insanely beautiful scenery.
A huge thank you to An and his family for such a special day. We couldn’t recommend this tour more!

An Unforgettable Experience
Nov 2025 • Friends
There are many ways to visit Starfish Beach on Phu Quoc Island, and I especially recommend Nhà Trên Biển - Joy Adventures. This authentic seafood restaurant, located on stilts over the water, left a lasting impression on me with its excellent service and food quality.
I originally booked for November 7, but on the morning of my visit, it was raining heavily in Phu Quoc. The restaurant's contact person, John, proactively reached out to inform me that the conditions at Starfish Beach were not suitable for a visit and even sent us a clip of the situation for reference.
At the same time, they suggested that we could either cancel our booking or reschedule. Their customer-focused approach is truly commendable and sets a great example for other business owners. Eventually, we were able to reschedule for November 9.
On the day of our visit, everything was wonderful. Not only was the weather perfect, but what made it truly unforgettable was the sunny smiles of all the staff, their warmth and hospitality, the fresh and delicious seafood, and the exclusive speedboat transport for all guests to and from Starfish Beach and other activities in the fishing village. It was absolutely spectacular!
I sincerely thank the restaurant for their meticulous care, and I wish everyone there happiness and good health!

Honest, simple seafood spot with warm people
Jun 2025 • Family
This spot is in Rach Vem fishing village, where you sit in a wooden house on stilts right above the sea, eating fresh seafood and watching the waves.
Last time I came to this area, I visited another place. This time I picked this one and I really appreciate how honest and friendly the owner is. 
Many places here just want to sell you a boat trip to Mui Ham Rong for starfish, whether it’s worth it or not. But here, they actually asked someone out there to send back a video so we could see if the water was clear and the starfish were around — no one wants to pay for a rough sea with no starfish! That’s the kind of honesty you rarely find. 
The seafood is simple, local and tasty, with fair prices. They also have clam picking around the house — they raise the clams themselves — but only fun when the water is clear enough. The sunset view can be lovely too. Just remember: it’s a fishing village, so it’s quiet, rustic, and the road back is dark if you stay late. Plan ahead.
I’m giving 5 stars not because everything is perfect, but because the people here are kind and real. It’s the kind of local experience you can’t get in the center of town — just come in the right season for the best views and clear water.

Lunch for two
Nov 2024 • Couples
We discovered this hidden gem through Google, drawn in by its glowing reviews. After visiting the Pepper Country Farm, which was conveniently just a 15-minute scooter ride away, we decided to stop by for lunch. The day was particularly windy, so we opted out of taking the boat to Starfish Beach. Instead, we had the pleasure of chatting with Jonathan and his girlfriend Joy, the warm and welcoming owners of this unique establishment. What makes their setup truly remarkable is that they actually live on the water, a detail that adds to the charm and allure of the experience.

Reaching the restaurant is an adventure in itself. The approach involves walking along a 200-meter-long wooden bridge—uneven and full of character—which perfectly encapsulates the authenticity of traditional Vietnamese life by the sea. It felt like stepping into a different world.

For our meal, we chose the silver pomfret fish, served with tomatoes and steamed rice. It arrived beautifully presented in the classic Vietnamese style, and we were delighted by its simplicity and flavor. The fish was tender, easy to eat with minimal bones, and absolutely delicious. Initially, we were the only diners, as the blustery weather had likely kept others away. However, a group of five arrived shortly after, and their presence only added to the atmosphere—our private, tranquil lunch spot came alive with a gentle hum of activity.

I wholeheartedly recommend this restaurant to anyone exploring the area. On a calmer day, the boat trip to Starfish Beach would undoubtedly enhance the experience, and I hope to return to try it myself when the weather is more agreeable.

One thing to note: the final stretch of the journey—about a quarter mile—is quite bumpy for scooters, and cars can only go so far. If you’re driving, you’ll need to walk the last 400 meters. Trust me, though, it’s well worth the effort!
